Sandbox_CompanionAlpaca_AlpacaSpawnMulti: Scales how often stray alpacas appear on farms and, rarely, in pet stores and vet clinics. 1.0 is the normal rate, 2.0 doubles them, 0 turns alpaca spawns off. This is separate from the dog spawn setting: turning stray dogs down or off does not take the alpacas with them.
